newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rexrodt praises Buba's 2-year M3 corridor.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt praises Buba's 2-year M3 corridor.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt on Thursday added his support to a decision by the Bundesbank to set a tighter two-year money supply growth target to cover the runup to European monetary union.
"The two-year target shows that the Bundesbank will observe its responsibility for a stability-oriented monetary policy until the handover to the European central bank," Rexrodt said in a statement.
"It will thus create a good launchpad for a successful start by the European central bank and for a stable euro," he added.
Rexrodt added that the tighter 3.5-6.5 percent M3 growth corridor would create the monetary preconditions for sustained economic growth and job creation.
